bug_summary: catcacheのwith_cache_tupdescがRefCellの借用を保持したままコールバックを呼び、TOAST化されたカタログタプルの再入(double-borrow)でpanicしていた。加えてruleutilsのキャスト表示でtypmodが常に-1にハードコードされていた
pr_title: Remove unported exprIsLengthCoercion seam and streamline tupdesc cache access
pr_description: Drops the not-yet-ported exprIsLengthCoercion seam and its registration; the cast deparse path in ruleutils now uses -1 for the coerced typmod, matching the common non-length-coercion case. Also simplifies with_cache_tupdesc to invoke the callback directly against the stored descriptor rather than resolving a raw pointer outside the borrow first.
